rule: FROZEN before scoring; do not edit items after a model has seen them. Different wording from cards_dev.json and cards_held_out.json (v1, 2026-09-29.1). 18 card-worthy across all kinds (3 checklist, 3 comparison, 3 timeline, 3 facts, 3 mixed), 9 plain, 9 near-miss (3 list-in-prose, 2 short-list, 2 code-only, 2 explanation-with-bullets).  Thresholds unchanged: >= 15 of 18 card-worthy produce a valid card, 0 spurious on plain/near-miss, every card validates.
